package demo;
public class Panel extends BWebServlet {
  public void doPost(WebOp op) throws Exception {
    post(restart, null, cx);
  }
  @NiagaraRpc(permissions = "r")
  public BValue reset(BValue arg) {
    target.post(resetAction, arg, null);
    return null;
  }
  public void doRestart(BValue arg, Context cx) {
    this.post(restart, arg);
  }
  public void handle(HttpServletRequest req, HttpServletResponse res) {
    comp.post(restart,
        arg, cx);
  }
}
